name: Kaufman Adaptive MA
description: This keyword returns the Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632223714.png)

You can plot the  Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average  on any series, like open in the above example, you can also plot EMA of RSI, High etc

parameters.name: Series
parameters.description: Nested series keyword to operate on, e.g. CLOSE(...), OPEN(...), HIGH(...).
